description: Use this when the user wants to find specific fashion products (clothing, footwear, accessories) by text, optionally guided by images. Pass `gender` when you know who the clothes are for. Do not use this for full outfit generation or visualization-only requests. The result's `content` is a plain-text list of the products (brand, price); `structuredContent.products` holds the same products with ids and shop links.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the shopper is in (e.g. 'DE', 'US'), if known. Used to show shops that deliver there.

gender.description: Who the clothes are for: 'female' or 'male'. Set it whenever the user says or the conversation suggests it ('for my boyfriend', 'women's', a gender they mentioned earlier, the kind of piece they ask for). Only ask the user if there is no hint at all and the answer would clearly differ by gender. Omit for unisex requests.

name: semantic_search
title: Search fashion products
